critique: FAIL: 1. **Text truncation in left card**: Point 2 text `<text x='35' y='10' font-size='14' fill='#FFFFFF'>` with content 'Maintains encoder-decoder structure,' is followed by `<tspan x='35' dy='18'>both are stacks of identical layers.</tspan>` but the `<tspan>` elements are incorrectly nested. The `<tspan>` tags are placed outside the `<text>` element as siblings, causing the second line 'both are stacks of identical layers.' to not render at all. **Fix**: Move `<tspan>` elements inside the `<text>` element: `<text x='35' y='10' font-size='14' fill='#FFFFFF'>Maintains encoder-decoder structure,<tspan x='35' dy='18'>both are stacks of identical layers.</tspan></text>`. Same issue exists for Points 3, 4, and 5 where `<tspan>` elements are orphaned outside their parent `<text>` elements. 2. **Incomplete text in Point 4**: The text reads 'Residual connections and layer' but should continue with 'normalization around each sub-layer' per the SVG source, but the `<tspan>` containing this continuation is outside the `<text>` element. **Fix**: Restructure all point text elements to properly nest `<tspan>` children: `<text x='35' y='10' font-size='14' fill='#FFFFFF'>Residual connections and layer<tspan x='35' dy='18'>normalization around each sub-layer</tspan></text>`. 3. **Incomplete text in Point 5**: 'Positional Encodings added to input' is missing 'embeddings to inject sequence order' due to same `<tspan>` nesting error. **Fix**: Correct nesting structure for Point 5 as well.
